[SHI International Corp](https://www.shi.com/) sells enterprise IT hardware, software licenses, and cloud computing services. Rather than acting as a standard retail store, it operates as a global technology solutions provider and value-added reseller (VAR) serving corporate, government, healthcare, and academic organizations. [](https://www.globaldata.com/company-profile/shi-international-corp/)

- **Computers & Devices:** Laptops, desktops, workstations, and mobile devices.

- **Data Center Equipment:** Servers, storage arrays, networking gear, and high-performance cables.

- **Peripherals:** Printers, printing supplies, cameras, video conferencing units, and power management tools. [](https://www.shidirect.com/)

### Software & Licensing

- **Volume Licensing:** Authorized enterprise software agreements from major publishers like Microsoft, Adobe, Oracle, IBM, and VMware.

- **Security Software:** Endpoint protection, threat intelligence, and firewall solutions from vendors like CrowdStrike and Palo Alto Networks. [](https://www.g2.com/products/shi/reviews)

### Services & Cloud Solutions

- **Cloud Services:** Infrastructure-as-a-Service (IaaS), Platform-as-a-Service (PaaS), and cloud cost-optimization assessments.

- **IT Lifecycle Services:** Custom device configuration, warehouse staging, asset management tracking, and deployment services. [](https://www.shi.com/)
